order.description: list order (KOR-32): created = created_at DESC (default), activity = last_activity_at DESC, urgency = the most urgent first, then last_activity_at DESC (E-43, ADR-101 section 2); the cursor of next_before follows the order

status.description: only tasks with this status (ADR-100 section 5)

urgency.description: only tasks with this urgency (ADR-100 section 5)

assignee.description: only tasks of this person, or none: only tasks without a person (ADR-100 section 5)

topic.description: only tasks of this topic, or none: only tasks without a topic (ADR-100 section 5)
